title: Travel-series phrase-topology review
purpose: Use repeated phrases inside Shoju's travel-poem series as source-local evidence for lexical boundaries and scene continuity, without treating phrase repetition as proof of the recombined candidate's whole-sentence naturalness.

exact_or_embedded_repetitions.additional_same_author_support: 高野山釈教長歌 参るなかたひ -> 長旅

exact_or_embedded_repetitions.dictionary_support: まはる / 回る・廻る is historical ラ行四段

exact_or_embedded_repetitions.note: Yamauchi's visible transcription explicitly prints 日 in the relevant 90/91/94 contexts, strengthening a 日-related reading without resolving every syntax.

series_evidence: はまも recurs as the start of poem 91 ku4.
The travel series repeatedly contrasts/combines shore/land-like surfaces such as はま and くかち.

dictionary_supported_hypothesis.segmentation: はまも + くが + も + と
dictionary_supported_hypothesis.gloss_candidate: 浜も + 陸 + も + と
support: 陸（くが） is an attested classical noun for land and land-route context.
Normalized くか may correspond to voiced くが in the research normalization layer.

poem_90_ku5_review.blocking_issue: The final と and whole ku/sentence relation are not poem-specifically annotated; do not promote this segmentation to source text.

reasons_not_to_promote_to_deep_review_su: The recombined sentence-level syntax across donor/host ku boundaries remains unannotated.
Dictionary and series-internal phrase topology do not equal original source-glyph confirmation.
The family still lacks a clean negative control showing the boundary of the same operation inside the same narrow travel scene.

reverse_candidate_effect.blocking_issue: はまもくかもと still lacks a complete source-safe syntax parse.

family_verdict.new_insight: The travel series is not merely title-coherent; it contains a network of repeated mirrored phrases that likely function as reusable authorial palindrome building blocks.

safety_rule.rule: Exact phrase recurrence within the same authorial series may support segmentation, morphology, and scene continuity, but it does not by itself certify the naturalness or syntax of a newly recombined whole poem.

next_action: Search Yamauchi's lexical analysis or original images for explicit interpretation of くかち／やとちかく／はまも; otherwise retain the travel candidate at promising-but-parse-needed and shift corpus-expansion effort to new verified poems.
